title_zh: 把洪水救助物资分区放好

scenario.label_zh: 分配洪水救助物资整理工作
scenario.goal_zh: 确认临时物资间和大件捐赠物的安放位置

context_zh: 志愿者向救助点送来捐赠物，协调员说明临时物资间的安排。
author: author-phase05-b

sentences.speaker: Wes
sentences.text: We would like to donate these blankets for families affected by the flood.

sentences.speaker: Alma
sentences.text: Thank you. The old meeting room is our temporary store during this emergency.

sentences.speaker: Wes
sentences.text: Should I carry everything straight in? We also have a large table in the van.

sentences.speaker: Alma
sentences.text: Bring the blankets to the left-hand shelves. Please leave the table beside the loading door until two people can move it safely.

sentences.speaker: Wes
sentences.text: The blankets are packed in labelled bags. I will stack them on those shelves.

sentences.speaker: Alma
sentences.text: Good. I will record the donation and find someone to help with the table.

sentences.speaker: Wes
sentences.text: I will stay by the van until the table team is ready, so it does not block the entrance.
